_comment: OUT-OF-SCOPE pret labels: things this port is NOT going to translate, excluded
from the completeness scores in docs/translation_progress.md so that report says
what still needs WRITING rather than counting work nobody will ever do.
MAINTAINER-CONTROLLED. An agent MUST NOT add an entry here to make its own
numbers look better - that is the same failure mode CLAUDE.md's rules about the
pret_label_allowlist exist to prevent. Entries are added only when the maintainer
says so, and each one states WHY the label is unportable rather than merely unported.
'Unused in pret' is NOT a reason to exclude. Maintainer direction 2026-08-23:
unused pret routines get ported anyway when they are genuinely portable in this
framework, for completeness and bug compatibility, even if they stay unlinked -
uncalled code does not run, so it carries no runtime risk. GetwMoves and
OverwritewMoves were ported on exactly that basis, not excluded.
Excluded labels are still reported, in their own section, so the exclusion is
visible and auditable instead of silently shrinking the denominator.

home/pikachu_cries.asm.reason: The Game Boy's 1-bit wave-channel bit-bang loop for Pikachu's digitized voice. PlayPikachuPCM streams samples by writing rAUD3LEVEL in a tight timing loop; LoadNextSoundClipSample and PlaySoundClipSample are its inner helpers. The port cannot host this even in principle: its APU is virtual, and the per-device shims read rAUD3LEVEL ONCE PER audio_tick (src/audio/opl_shim.asm:707, src/audio/tandy_shim.asm:492), so a literal translation would emit silence rather than sound. The data model diverges too - tools/audio/gen_pika_pcm.py has already low-pass-filtered and decimated pret's 1-bit streams to 8-bit PCM. The cry itself IS implemented, faithfully and at its correct pret path: pret moved PlayPikachuSoundClip into audio/pikachu_pcm.asm (upstream bd1b695b) and the port mirrors it there, dispatching to the Sound Blaster DSP or the PC-speaker PWM player. src/audio/sb_pcm.asm:25 already carries the DEVIATION{class=HAL} for this replacement. Maintainer decision 2026-08-23.
